testcase.name: an added place counts towards the total
an added place sorts ahead of the catalog rather than into it
an added place can be rated and wishlisted like any other
an added place joins the catalog and is explored from the start
an address can be written onto a catalogued place
clearing an address stores nothing rather than an empty string
re-seeding an unchanged catalog does not touch anything
removing an added place takes its review with it
two places with the same name both survive under distinct ids
a later catalog never removes a place the user added
a catalogued place cannot be deleted by the same call
a place added without an address is still a place
